earlier_inventory.scope: Broad annotated screening inventory, not 187 full technical reviews.

selection: Connection to RQ1/RQ2/RQ3, an implemented comparison, a validity concern, or a closest contribution precedent.
reading_depth: Primary abstracts and selected method/evaluation passages; targeted critical synthesis, not a systematic review.
primary_sources: arXiv author records/papers, official proceedings, primary research reports, implementation authors and original statistical article.
